subtitle.zh-CN: 绿色小豆芽 · 两片叶子
subtitle.zh-TW: 綠色小豆芽 · 兩片葉子

description.zh-CN: 一颗刚发芽的小绿豆，头顶两片嫩叶，自信满满，觉得自己哪天能长成大树。
description.zh-TW: 一顆剛發芽的小綠豆，頭頂兩片嫩葉，自信滿滿，覺得自己哪天能長成大樹。
description.en: A freshly sprouted green bean with two tender leaves on top. Full of confidence that it will grow into a big tree one day.

look: little green bean-sprout spirit: soft pea-green kidney-bean body standing upright, one small two-leaf sprout on top of the head, round black eyes with white highlight, tiny confident smirk, short arms and legs with darker green hands and feet
